name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=input (the cursor-blink idle loop), descriptor=idle_last_rendered_tick (the BIOS tick value at which the cursor-blink frame was last composited), and the _word suffix correctly reflects the u16 data type as required by convention. No Ghidra address residue (no _539f2 hex tail; _word is a type tag, not an address). Name accurately matches the only two accessors in fd2_wait_for_input_with_idle.
purpose: Last BIOS midnight-tick (0:046C, 18.2 Hz word) value at which the cursor-blink frame was composited; serves as the throttle latch that paces idle redraws to ~18.2 Hz.
logic_summary: Read+written only by fd2_wait_for_input_with_idle (@0x11AA8). Each idle iteration (no key pending) snapshots the live BIOS tick from 0:046C, sign-extends both it (MOVSX EDX,AX) and this latch (MOVSX EAX,word ptr [0x539F2] @0x11AD2) and compares (CMP @0x11AD9). When they differ it calls fd2_composite_battle_frame(0) to redraw the blink frame, then stores the fresh tick here (MOV [0x539F2],AX @0x11AEF). Equal -> no redraw. This gives the ~18.2 Hz cursor blink. The sibling data_fd2_input_idle_current_bios_tick_word @0x539F0 is a write-only mirror; the redraw decision uses the register-held tick vs this latch, not that mirror.
element_semantics: Single u16 scalar latch holding the BIOS midnight-tick counter value (low 16 bits of the 0:046C dword, 18.2 Hz) at the moment of the most recent cursor-blink frame composite. Read sign-extended to 32 bits at the compare site.
notes: Memory at 0x539F2 is all-zero (BSS zero-init). Exactly two xrefs, both in fd2_wait_for_input_with_idle: READ @0x11AD2, WRITE @0x11AEF. is_const=false because the game writes it. comment_verdict=keep: src/input/input.c lines 698-707 already give a precise, ASCII, accurate block (matches asm incl. the MOVSX sign-extended read), so input.c was NOT edited. ghidra_plate_action=created: the accurate plate text was previously misplaced in PRE_COMMENT with PLATE_COMMENT null; migrated a refined version into PLATE_COMMENT and cleared PRE_COMMENT per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism (data plate must live in PLATE_COMMENT, PRE_COMMENT forbidden for data plates) via run_script_inline + cu.setComment in a transaction.
